module: Loading and unloading of a level on the game's "server" side (solo/freeroam mode). `createGame` opens the loading screen then runs the complete sequence: datablocks and materials, creation of the physics world, loading of the level objects (main/ JSON folder, or old .mis format), decals, starting the physics, creation of the camera and the player, then fade-out. `destroy` does the reverse. The duration of each step is logged.
usage:
server.createGame('/levels/gridmap_v2/info.json')
-- command line: server.setLevelOffset(100, 0, 0) before loading shifts the whole level
notes: Bug: M.loadingProgress is copied at module import while the local variable is assigned later (createGameActual); the exported field is therefore always nil.

Emitted hooks: onClientCustomObjectSpawning (after loading the objects), onPlayerCameraReady (after player spawn), onLoadingScreenFadeout (end of loading). UI event: MenuHide (fadeoutLoadingScreen with skipStart).
Do not remove the VariableRegistry.set('$loadingLevel', ...): used on the C++ side.
If the level is not found or there is no MissionGroup, createGameActual logs an error and stops without a fade-out.
Non-exported local functions: endMission (cleans MissionGroup, MissionCleanup, decals, audio…) and patchLoadingContext (applies the level offset).

loadingProgress.desc: Exported at module initialization, hence nil (see notes); the real value is the local LoadingManager handle.

createGame.desc: Loads a level. Requests the loading screen from core_gamestate, then runs createGameActual (datablocks, materials, objects, physics, camera and player spawn). If customLoadingFunction is given, the fade-out is delayed: that function must call server.fadeoutLoadingScreen.

levelPath.desc: level path (info.json, .mis or folder/level name; lowercased)

customLoadingFunction.desc: called instead of the automatic fade-out

destroy.desc: Destroys the session: sets $missionRunning to false, ends the level (endMission), destroys the physics world, deletes the datablocks and increments $Server::Session.

p.desc: optional profiler exposing :add(name) to mark the steps

fadeoutLoadingScreen.desc: Finishes the loading: requests leaving the loading screen, calls clientPostStartMission/clientStartMission (unless skipStart), ends the loading, emits onLoadingScreenFadeout and logs the duration. No effect (warning) if no loading is in progress.

skipStart.desc: if true, skips clientPostStartMission/clientStartMission and triggers guihooks MenuHide

setLevelOffset.desc: Sets a global offset applied to the tile transform of the next loaded level. Calling without an argument removes the offset; with incomplete arguments, logs an error.

x.desc: X offset in meters; nil cancels the offset
